fusions.name: Out of Still Water
fusions.desc: Lunges a hooked chain at an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 30 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach. It always lands as a critical hit, and its damage rises 5% for every 10% of health the target still has, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Rolling Grip
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.5 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Jaws
fusions.desc: Conjures a set of chained iron jaws at the nearest enemy. They wait up to 1 minute; the first enemy to come within 2 tiles springs them, which deals 20 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Drowning Hold
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below 50% health.
